scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Lately, it has been said that
they are developing ways to add options
to put in sockets or add statuses
on equipment that normally don't have it.
They call that ^006400Enchant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
最近听说，
有人正在研究一种方法，
可以将选项添加到插槽中，
或者为原本没有这些功能的装备添加状态。
他们称之为^006400附魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
After seeing that being developed,
I was so inspired by it
that I worked hard to discover
a way to do it and I finally
made my own way to ^006400Enchant^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看到这项技术被开发出来后，
我深受启发，
努力研究并终于
找到了自己的^006400附魔^000000方法！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
But in order do to this
I need some special materials.
If you're okay with it...
Do you think you can
help me out by gathering them?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
但是为了做到这一点，
我需要一些特殊的材料。
如果你不介意的话...
你能帮我收集它们吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I can help out!
scripts.translation: 当然，我可以帮忙！

scripts.text: I'm a little busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
However, looking at you
in your current state makes me
doubt your ability to gather
the items I need...
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
不过，看你现在的状态，
我对你收集所需物品的能力
有些怀疑...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Well, I guess if you employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 for this
then I think I can entrust you
with my requests... right?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好吧，我想如果你雇佣一名^006400佣兵^000000来做这件事，
那我应该可以信任你
并委托你我的请求...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary,
go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
为了雇佣佣兵，
请去^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近的
^006400佣兵公会^000000。
去找^006400资讯特工^000000，
询问^006400佣兵公会官员^000000的位置，
他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now... Hurry and employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在...快去雇佣一名^006400佣兵^000000，
然后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Well since you said you're busy
I can't be helped...
When you're not so busy, come find me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
既然你说你很忙，
我也没办法...
等你不那么忙的时候，再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You haven't gotten a mercenary yet.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你还没有雇佣佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary,
go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
为了雇佣佣兵，
请去^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近的
^006400佣兵公会^000000。
去找^006400资讯特工^000000，
询问^006400佣兵公会官员^000000的位置，
他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now... Hurry and employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在...快去雇佣一名^006400佣兵^000000，
然后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Seeing you with a ^006400Mercenary^000000 definitely makes me trust you more.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看到你带着^006400佣兵^000000，
确实让我更信任你了。

scripts.output:
[教学指导员]
如果^006400佣兵^000000通过为您战斗
来提供直接帮助，
那么^006400宠物^000000则通过它们的能力
和多样的外观为您提供间接帮助，
并俘获您的心。
今后也请尝试培养一只^006400宠物^000000吧。
scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If a 006400Mercenary^000000 gives you direct effect
by fighting for you
then a ^006400Pet^000000 helps you indirectly with their
abilities and varied appearances,
and it captures your heart.
Try raising a ^006400Pet^000000 in the future as well.

[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, let's see... In order to
get this ^006400Enchant^000000 to succeed
you have to go gather some materials for me...
What I need is...
..............
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在，让我看看...为了
让这次^006400附魔^000000成功，
你必须去为我收集一些材料...
我需要的是...
..............

scripts.text: I don't think I heard you clearly...
scripts.translation: 我没听清楚...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
I really don't like to repeat myself..
If you ask me again like that
does it just make your mouth tired?
In these situations, open your ^006400Quest Window^000000
and you can see what is requested of you
and the details of my request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
我真的不喜欢重复自己...
如果你再这样问我，
难道只是让你的嘴巴累吗？
在这种情况下，打开你的^006400任务窗口^000000，
你可以看到所需的内容
以及我请求的详细信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果你看左上角
信息区域，
上面写着^006400任务^000000，
点击它
就会显示所有
与请求相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you verify what materials
you need go gather from
the ^006400Quest Window^000000,
come find and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一旦你从^006400任务窗口^000000中
确认了需要的材料，
就去收集它们，
然后回来再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You seemed to be sluggish with a lot of items
in your inventory making you heavy...
It'll be hard to do my request
when you're heavy with all that junk!
Go empty out your inventory and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你看起来因为背包里有很多物品
而显得笨重...
当你带着这么多杂物时，
很难完成我的请求！
去清空你的背包，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems that you have
one too many items on you...
If you want to help me out
then you're gonna have to put some
stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你身上带了
太多的物品...
如果你想帮我，
那就得先整理一下东西，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Did you open your ^006400Quest Window^000000
to verify the materials?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你打开^006400任务窗口^000000
确认过需要的材料了吗？

scripts.text: Yup!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text: Where is the Quest Window...
scripts.translation: 任务窗口在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Oh yeah? Then shall I test you to see
if you really checked it?
Write down what material I asked you to get.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
哦？那我来考考你，
看看你是不是真的确认过了。
写下我让你去收集的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Good, you know.
Now, are you feeling pretty familiar
about the ^006400Quest Window^000000?
But there is an issue...
You know what material to collect,
but gathering that won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
很好，你知道了。
现在，你对^006400任务窗口^000000
是不是已经比较熟悉了？
不过还有个问题...
你知道要收集什么材料，
但收集它们可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Also, there is one thing
I absolutely think you need to try.
And that is...
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
另外，有一件事
我绝对认为你需要尝试一下。
那就是...
^006400通用银目录^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
can be obtained from
the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
that is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400通用银目录^000000
可以从位于乐园团总部的
^0000FF目录巫师^000000那里获得。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, go and obtain
a ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come back and talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在，去获取一本
^006400通用银目录^000000，
然后回来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You... still don't seem
to know much about the
^006400Quest Window^000000.
I will inform you again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你...看起来还是不太了解
^006400任务窗口^000000。
我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hurry and check to see
what materials are required in
your ^006400Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
快点去你的^006400任务窗口^000000
查看一下需要哪些材料。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果你看左上角
信息区域，
上面写着^006400任务^000000，
点击它
就会显示所有
与请求相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you verify what materials
you need go gather from
the ^006400Quest Window^000000,
come find and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一旦你从^006400任务窗口^000000中
确认了需要的材料，
就去收集它们，
然后回来再和我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hmm? So I noticed that
you haven't gone and picked up a
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 yet!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
嗯？我注意到你
还没有去领取
^006400通用银目录^000000！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You can get the
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
from the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
who is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你可以从位于乐园团总部的
^0000FF目录巫师^000000那里
获得^006400通用银目录^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go and get the
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
所以，去领取
^006400通用银目录^000000，
然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Oh! You managed to get a
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
哦！你成功获得了
^006400通用银目录^000000！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
This lets you browse and search
through all the various stores
that are on the same map and
are open for vending.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
它可以让你浏览和搜索
同一张地图上
所有正在营业的露天商店。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It only costs 200 zeny for one
of these and with it you can
search up to 10 times.
You can say that it's a necessity.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一本只要200 Zeny，
而且可以搜索10次。
可以说它是必需品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go to the area you want
and try out the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come and find me
after you've done this.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
所以，去你想去的区域
试用一下^006400通用银目录^000000，
做完之后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hmm... It seems that you still have
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 in your inventory.
Since you're saying you forgot how to use it
I'll explain it to you again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
嗯...看来你的背包里
还有^006400通用银目录^000000。
既然你说你忘了怎么用，
我再给你解释一遍。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You see... the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
lets you browse and search
through all the various stores
that are on the same map and
are open for vending.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你看...^006400通用银目录^000000
可以让你浏览和搜索
同一张地图上
所有正在营业的露天商店。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go to the area you want
and try out the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
them come and find me
after you've done this.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
所以，去你想去的区域
试用一下^006400通用银目录^000000，
做完之后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
How do you feel after trying out
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000?
It feels a lot easier than
going through each individual
vendor and finding the item
you need, right?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
试用了^006400通用银目录^000000之后感觉如何？
比起一个个去找商人，
这样找东西是不是方便多了？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, go out and gather
the materials I need and
I will make sure to give you
a fantastic ^006400enchant^000000!
I'll be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在，去收集我需要的材料，
我会为你施加一个超棒的^006400附魔^000000！
我会在这里等你的！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems you didn't bring
enough materials. Did you forget
what you needed to gather?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你带的材料不够。
是不是忘了要收集什么了？

scripts.text: Yeah...
scripts.translation: 是啊...

scripts.text: Nope!
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
I've been told that if you click the
thing on the top left that says
^006400QUEST^000000, it'll show you all
the information that you need
that pertains to your requests.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
听说如果你点击左上角写着
^006400任务^000000的按钮，
就能看到所有与你请求相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you gather all the materials
that are listed in your ^006400Quest Window^000000
come and talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
收集齐^006400任务窗口^000000里列出的所有材料后，
再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
When you gather the items
come to me and I will show you
an awesome ^006400ENCHANT^000000.
I'll be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
收集好物品后就来找我，
我会展示一个超棒的^006400附魔^000000。
我会在这里等你的！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Your inventory seems to be really full
with various stuff... Do you think
you can get anything done when you're so
weighed down? Go put some stuff away
then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你的背包里好像塞满了各种东西...
这么沉重的负担，
你觉得还能做什么事吗？
先把一些东西收起来，
然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You seem to have too much stuff
in your inventory... Go put some
stuff away then come back to me
when you have less suff on you.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你的背包里好像有太多东西了...
先把一些东西收起来，
等你身上的物品少一点了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You got everything I asked for!
So~ Shall we start on the awesome
Enchant that I found and developed?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你把我需要的东西都带来了！
那么~我们要开始研究
我开发出的那个超棒的附魔了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Okay! Now for the first skill!!
To add a new ability to your armor...
^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好！第一个技能！！
给防具添加新能力...
^006400隐藏孔附魔^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
And for the second skill!!
To add a new socket into your
weapon and shield...
^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
第二个技能！！
给武器和盾牌添加新孔位...
^006400孔位附魔^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
There. The Enchant is done. You can't understand the process by just watching me, so I'll let you look at the items themselves.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好了，附魔完成了。光看我操作你是理解不了过程的，所以我让你自己看看这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Those items cannot be
worn or traded so don't even
think about running away with them.
When you're done looking at them,
give them back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
这些物品不能穿戴也不能交易，
所以别打什么歪主意想把它拿走。
看完之后，
请把它们还给我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
What did you do with the Enchanted
items I lent to you to look at?
Until you bring back the fruits of
my labor, I don't want to talk to you,
let alone see your face.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
我借给你看的那些附魔物品呢？
在你把我的劳动成果还回来之前，
我不想跟你说话，
更不想看到你的脸。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Are you done looking over
the items I Enchanted?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你看完我附魔的物品了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, thank you.
scripts.translation: 是的，谢谢。

scripts.text: I haven't looked at them yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没看呢。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So what did you think after inspecting it? Now that you've looked at an actual Enchanted item, do you understand it?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
那你检查之后觉得怎么样？既然你已经看过真正的附魔物品了，你理解了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Thanks to you I was able to see great results of my research and study.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
多亏了你，我才能看到我的研究和学习的成果。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you have any questions about anything that I discussed with you, I will tell you everything! Thanks for your hard work!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果你对我刚才讲的内容有任何疑问，我会为你解答一切！
感谢你的辛勤付出！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Take your time to look them over
then bring them back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
请慢慢检查，
看完后再把它们带回来给我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你还有什么疑问吗？

scripts.text: Can I do the same quest again?
scripts.translation: 我可以再次接取相同的任务吗？

scripts.text: About the Quest Window...
scripts.translation: 关于任务窗口...

scripts.text: About ENCHANT...
scripts.translation: 关于附魔...

scripts.text: About Searching Vends...
scripts.translation: 关于搜索商店...

scripts.text: About Mercenary and Pets...
scripts.translation: 关于佣兵和宠物...

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The one method to do the same quests repeatdedly is to do the ^006400Daily Quests^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
想要重复进行相同的任务，唯一的方法就是做^006400每日任务^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you complete a ^006400Daily Quest^000000 and turn it in, wait about a day then come back to get the request and do it all over again!
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you received a daily quest, look at bottom right of the ^006400Quest Window^000000. There is a section that is called ^006400LIMITED^000000. In that section, it'll tell you how much time needs to pass before you can pick up another daily quest.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
完成^006400每日任务^000000并交付后，等待大约一天，再回来接取任务并重新开始！
[教学指导员]
如果你接取了每日任务，请查看^006400任务窗口^000000的右下角。那里有一个名为^006400限时^000000的区域，它会显示距离可以接取下一个每日任务还需要多少时间。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems you still have some time left to wait out after finishing my quest. Wait it out a bit more, then come find me and you can get the same quest again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你完成我的任务后，还需要等待一段时间。再等一会儿，然后来找我，就可以再次接取相同的任务了。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems that about a day has passed since you've finished my quest. Alright, so like the ^006400Daily Quests^000000, you can get a quest from me. Did you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来距离你完成我的任务已经过了一天。好的，就像^006400每日任务^000000一样，你可以从我这里接取任务。你想继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Okay. But if you change your mind and want to receive a quest, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好的。但如果你改变主意想要接取任务，请随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
They say that the ^006400Quest Window^000000 details out everything you need to know about your quests.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
据说^006400任务窗口^000000会详细列出你需要知道的所有任务信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果你看左上角
信息区域，
上面写着^006400任务^000000，
点击它
就会显示所有
与请求相关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Using the ^006400Quest Window^000000 will make your life easier. It'll tell you where to go, what items to get or who to find and etc.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
使用^006400任务窗口^000000会让你的生活更轻松。它会告诉你去哪里、获取什么物品或寻找谁等。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400ENCHANT^000000, in general, is divided into two parts: ^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 and ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000.

[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is used to add a SOCKET into equipments and ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is used to put in stats into a socket of an armor.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400镶嵌附魔^000000用于在装备上添加镶嵌孔，而^006400隐藏镶嵌附魔^000000用于在护甲的镶嵌孔中填入属性。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Of course, in order to do this we are in need of some materials and there is a chance that it may fail, but that's the risk you're taking.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
当然，为了做到这一点，我们需要一些材料，而且有可能失败，但这就是你要承担的风险。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The people who do the ^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 can be found in ^8B4513Prontera, Morocc, Payon,^000000. ^8B4513Rhitalzen^000000 is in the Refinery and ^0000FFSeiyablem^000000 and ^0000FFReiablem^000000 can be found near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
进行^006400镶嵌附魔^000000的人可以在^8B4513普隆德拉、莫洛奇、斐扬^000000找到。^8B4513瑞塔尔岑^000000在精炼厂，而^0000FF赛亚布雷姆^000000和^0000FF雷亚布雷姆^000000可以在入口附近找到。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The one who does ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is found at the 6 o'clock location of ^8B4513Prontera^000000. Look for the ^0000FFCraftman Apprentice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
进行^006400隐藏镶嵌附魔^000000的人位于^8B4513普隆德拉^000000的6点钟方向。请寻找^0000FF工匠学徒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Do you think you understand a little bit more about ^006400ENCHANT^000000?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你觉得自己对^006400附魔^000000稍微了解一些了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400Vend Search^000000 can be utilized by the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 item. Since you search through as vends on that map, it'll make it easier for you to find the item that you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400摆摊搜索^000000可以通过^006400万能银目录^000000道具来使用。由于它会搜索该地图上的所有摊位，所以能帮你更容易地找到想要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
can be obtained from 
the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
that is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400万能银目录^000000可以从位于乐园团团部的^0000FF目录巫师^000000处获得。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It only costs 200 zeny for one
of these and with it you can
search up to 10 times.
You can say that it's a necessity.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一本只要200 Zeny，
而且可以搜索10次。
可以说它是必需品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, are you getting familiar with ^006400Vend Search^000000? Don't just stand there and listen to me. Go ahead and try it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
那么，你熟悉^006400摆摊搜索^000000了吗？别光站在那里听我说，快去亲自试试吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Depending on what you need, ^006400Mercenary^000000 and ^006400Pet^000000 can be used in various ways.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
根据你的需求，^006400佣兵^000000和^006400宠物^000000可以以各种方式被使用。

scripts.output:
[教学指导员]
如果^006400雇佣兵^000000通过为您战斗提供直接效果，
那么^006400宠物^000000则通过它们的能力和多样的外观间接帮助您，
并俘获您的心。
scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If a 006400Mercenary^000000 gives you direct effect
by fighting for you
then a ^006400Pet^000000 helps you indirectly with their
abilities and varied appearances,
and it captures your heart.

[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary
Go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
为了雇佣佣兵，请前往位于^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近的^006400佣兵公会^000000。
去找^006400资讯特工^000000，询问^006400佣兵公会官员^000000的位置，他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to get a ^006400Pet^000000, while hunting you will obtain taming items. Use the tame on the monster it's for and you can get a pet.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
为了获得^006400宠物^000000，你在打怪时会获得驯服道具。对相应的魔物使用驯服道具，就可以获得宠物。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Because there is a chance for failure, please use the taming item with great care.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
由于驯服有失败的可能，请谨慎使用驯服道具。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
That aside... you can get a ^006400Mercenary^000000 from the Mercenary Guild and you can get a ^006400Pet^000000 by trading or buying it from another player.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
除此之外...你可以从佣兵公会雇佣^006400佣兵^000000，也可以通过与其他玩家交易或购买来获得^006400宠物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, do you understand a bit more about using a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and a ^006400Pet^000000? I hope you get a chance to use them in the future.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在，你对使用^006400佣兵^000000和^006400宠物^000000稍微了解一些了吗？希望你在未来有机会使用它们。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you have any questions, come find me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果你有任何问题，随时再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Lately, it has been said that
they are developing ways to add options
to put in sockets or add statuses
on equipment that normally don't have it.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
最近听说，他们正在开发一种方法，可以在原本没有镶嵌孔或属性的装备上添加镶嵌孔或属性。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You seem to be overweight with items. Go put some stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你身上的物品太重了。先去整理一下物品，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You have too many items on you. Go put some stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你身上的物品太多了。先去整理一下物品，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well~ We gotta go challenge the experts right?
Let's start off by finding the ^006400Siege Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嗯~ 我们得去挑战专家们对吧？
让我们先从寻找^006400攻城战专家^000000开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You've passed the ^006400Siege Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
Now, go find the ^006400Party Recruiting Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你通过了^006400攻城战专家^000000的测试！恭喜！
现在，去找^006400组队招募专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Oh! You've passed the ^006400Party Recruiting Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
Now, go find the ^006400Battleground Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
哦！你通过了^006400组队招募专家^000000的测试！恭喜！
现在，去找^006400战场专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Yay! You passed the test from the ^006400Battleground Expert^000000! Congrats!
Next, go and find the ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
耶！你通过了^006400战场专家^000000的测试！恭喜！
接下来，去找^006400记忆地下城专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You passed the test from ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000! That's great!
Try finding the ^006400Map Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你通过了^006400记忆地下城专家^000000的测试！太棒了！
试着去找找^006400地图专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You passed ^006400Map Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
I'm so glad that you were to pass all the Experts' tests! You're better than I expected!!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你通过了^006400地图专家^000000的测试！恭喜！
很高兴你能通过所有专家的测试！你比我预想的还要优秀！！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Now, even you are an ^006400Expert^000000!! Such a fitting nick name for you!
Thank you so much for your hard work. As promised, here is a small little reward for you.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
现在，你也成为了^006400专家^000000！！这真是再适合不过的名号了！
非常感谢你的努力。作为承诺，这是给你的小小奖励。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
I think it'll be useful to you during your adventures. I wish you luck on your future adventures~
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
我想这对你未来的冒险会有帮助。祝你未来的冒险旅途好运~

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]

I hope that your future adventures are filled with good luck.

希望你的未来冒险充满好运。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Hmm, I wonder if there is any adventurer that is smart enough to challenge our Experts...
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嗯，不知道有没有足够聪明的冒险者来挑战我们的专家...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Hey you! You look like an adventurer... Though you look a little dull...
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嘿，你！看起来像个冒险者...不过看起来有点迟钝...

scripts.text: What'd you say? I'm smart!
scripts.translation: 你说什么？我很聪明！

scripts.text: Yeah... I'm dull.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我确实有点迟钝。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Serious? Though I don't know if I can believe that. Look at the expert who is in front of me! He took up only one area of study for 16 years and now he is as dignified as can be!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
真的吗？虽然我不太确定该不该相信。看看我面前的这位专家！他花了16年只钻研一个领域，现在已经是德高望重的人物了！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well, if you manage to pass all their tests then I will believe in your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
好吧，如果你能通过他们所有的测试，我就会相信你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
And I will apologize for calling you dull. How about it, Dull Expert?! Do you want to challenge them?
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
而且我会为叫你迟钝而道歉。怎么样，迟钝的专家？！你想挑战他们吗？

scripts.text: Ch... Challenge!!
Um... I think I'll just give up now...
scripts.translation: 嗯...我想我还是现在放弃吧...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You're braver than you look. You can't go back now that you've decided to challenge!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你比你看起来要勇敢。既然决定了要挑战，就不能回头了！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Okay~ Start by talking to the ^006400Siege Expert^000000 who's right there in front.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
好的~ 先从面前这位^006400攻城战专家^000000开始对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well, don't get discouraged... If you change your mind and want to do the challenge, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嗯，别灰心...如果你改变主意想挑战的话，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Since you've come again, I assume you're curious about ^006400Siege^000000?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
既然你又来了，我猜你是对^006400攻城战^000000感到好奇？

scripts.text: Listen about Siege.
scripts.translation: 听听关于攻城战的事。

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Now that you've gone through all of this with an expert, isn't it easy to understand? If you want to go over anything, just come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
既然你已经和专家一起经历了一切，理解起来是不是很容易？如果你想回顾任何内容，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
If you want to go over anything, just come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
如果你想回顾任何内容，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
I am someone who has studied War of Emperium for 16 years! So that makes me an expert! Since you came to find me, I assume you want to learn more about ^006400Siege^000000.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
我研究攻城战已经16年了！所以我是专家！既然你找到我，想必是想了解更多关于^006400攻城战^000000的事情。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
You have great desire and enthusiasm. As the Expert of ^006400Siege^000000, you have motivated me! All the other Experts are waiting for you! Go get'em!
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
你充满了热情和渴望。作为^006400攻城战^000000的专家，你让我深受鼓舞！其他专家都在等你！去挑战他们吧！

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
If I told you that there was a great prize for being able to pass all the Experts' tests~ would you go for the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
如果我告诉你，通过所有专家的测试会有丰厚的奖励~你会接受这个挑战吗？

scripts.output:
[攻城战专家]

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
As the first Expert, I can teach you about ^006400Siege^000000. How about it? Did you wanna learn about ^006400Siege^000000s?
Listen about Siege.
scripts.translation: 听听关于攻城战的事。

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:

Now that you've gone through all of this with an expert, isn't it easy to understand?

scripts.translation:

既然你已经和专家一起经历了一切，理解起来是不是很容易？

scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
因此，为了进入^006400记忆地下城^000000，队伍首领必须申请进入。由于是按申请顺序进入，您必须保持待命状态以便进入。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Also, after you explore Memorial Dungeon, you cannot re-enter the same ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
另外，在探索完记忆地下城后，您在一定时间内无法再次进入同一个^006400记忆地下城^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Many ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000s exist, but we will give you hints to help you find Memorial Dungeon in the world of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
虽然存在许多^006400记忆地下城^000000，但我们会给您一些提示，帮助您在米德加尔特世界中找到记忆地下城。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
First, go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 and find ^006400Captain Jansen^000000.
He will give you information about the really huge and tall dungeon known as ^006400Endless Tower^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
首先，前往^8B4513艾尔贝塔^000000，找到^006400詹森船长^000000。
他会给你关于那座巨大且高耸的地下城——^006400无尽之塔^000000的信息。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Second, go to the ^8B4513Orc Map^000000 where all the orcs live and find the ^006400Insane Scientist^000000.
You might be able to get some information about a dungeon that has to do with ^006400Orc's Memory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
其次，前往所有兽人居住的^8B4513兽人地图^000000，找到^006400疯狂的科学家^000000。
你或许能从中获得关于与^006400兽人的记忆^000000有关的地下城的信息。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Third and last, seek out the place where you can become a monk, which is the ^8B4513Capitolina Monastery^000000 and seek out ^006400Detective Patrick^000000.
He will be able to give you information about the dungeon with the ^006400Sealed Baphomet^000000+.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
最后，前往可以成为武僧的地方，即^8B4513卡波利纳修道院^000000，寻找^006400侦探帕特里克^000000。
他能给你关于封印着^006400巴风特^000000+的地下城的信息。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Of course there are other locations for Memorial Dungeon but it's best to start where you can find it easily.
As you continue to go on your adventures you will be able to find them more easily.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
当然，记忆地下城还有其他地点，但最好从容易找到的地方开始。
随着你继续冒险，你会更容易找到它们。

scripts.text:

Seeing that you came to me, I assume you have some questions about ^006400MAP^000000s?
scripts.translation:

既然你找来了，我猜你是有关于^006400地图^000000的问题？

scripts.translation: 结束对话。

If you end up in those areas while you're adventuring, be sure to tell me all about it!
And now, since you've passed all the Expert's quizzes, go on and talk to ^006400Tutorial Goal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
如果你在冒险中到了那些区域，一定要告诉我所有情况！
现在，既然你已经通过了所有专家的测验，去和^006400教学目标^000000谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you have any more questions, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
如果你还有更多问题，来找我。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
I have been researching and studying ^006400MAP^000000s for 16 years and so now I am the ^006400MAP^000000 Expert!
Since you've sought me out, it seems you've passed ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000's quiz.
scripts.translation:

我研究并学习^006400地图^000000已经16年了，所以现在我是^006400地图^000000专家！
既然你找来了，看来你已经通过了^006400记忆地下城专家^000000的测验。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Bingo! You got all 3 answers correct! Now, do you feel like you understand stuff about ^006400MAP^000000s more?
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
太棒了！你答对了所有3个问题！现在，你觉得自己对^006400地图^000000的了解更深了吗？

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you ever feel like you want to learn more about ^006400MAP^000000s, come talk to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
如果你以后想更多地了解^006400地图^000000，随时来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Congrats on passing all the Experts' quizzes! Now, go find and talk to the ^006400Tutorial Goal^000000!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
恭喜通过所有专家的测验！现在，去找^006400教学目标^000000并和它对话吧！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
The 3 questions shouldn't have been that hard...
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
这3个问题应该不难才对...

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Well, you seem to be pretty smart so why not try the quiz again?
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
嗯，你看起来挺聪明的，要不要再试一次测验？

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
How is this Expert's explanations? Now I am gonna give you a quick quiz. You have to get all the answers correct to pass. Want to try it?
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
这位专家的解释如何？现在我要给你出几道快速测验题。你必须全部答对才能通过。想试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
我是最后一位专家！别放弃！准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
You're gonna give up without even trying? But I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
你连试都不试就要放弃吗？但我可是最后一位专家！别放弃！准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you want to learn from me, go get acknowledged by the ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
如果你想向我学习，先去^006400记忆地下城^000000那里获得认可吧。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
A ^006400MAP^000000 shows you things that is much needed for travelling around the world; such as the lay of the land, major towns and fields and such. It's a very important tool!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
^006400地图^000000展示了你在世界各地旅行时非常需要的信息；比如地形、主要城镇和野外区域等。它是非常重要的工具！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Because of this, it's more important than everything else that you know about ^006400MAP^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
因此，了解^006400地图^000000比了解其他任何事情都更重要。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
The map can be accessed by clicking on the button that says ^006400MAP^000000 on the upper left side of your screen.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
你可以点击屏幕左上角标有^006400地图^000000的按钮来打开地图。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
When you click on the ^006400MAP^000000 button, a full sized map of Midgard will take up your screen.
When you ^0000FFHover your mouse over specific areas^000000, you can find out more things such as ^006400NAME^000000 and Area Details.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
当你点击^006400地图^000000按钮时，米德加尔特的全尺寸地图会占据你的屏幕。
当你^0000FF将鼠标悬停在特定区域^000000时，你可以找到更多信息，例如^006400名称^000000和区域详情。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you look to the lower right side of your map, there is a ^006400Poring drawing^000000.
If you click on it or press the ^006400TAB^000000 shortcut key, you will be able to various information.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
在地图的右下角，有一个^006400波利涂鸦^000000。
点击它或按下^006400TAB^000000快捷键，你可以查看各种信息。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Firstly, you can find out the ^006400NAME^000000 and ^006400LEVEL^000000 of the monsters in each area. That will take a lot of the guess work out of where you want to go hunt.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
首先，你可以查看各个区域魔物的^006400名称^000000和^006400等级^000000。这能帮你省去很多猜测，让你更清楚该去哪里打怪。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Secondly, You can locate various ^006400DUNGEON^000000s and their
^006400Entrance Location^000000. Plus, it'll also tell you monsters that reside in that area
along with their ^006400LEVEL^000000. It's displayed in red so it's easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
其次，你可以找到各个^006400地下城^000000及其^006400入口位置^000000。此外，它还会显示该区域居住的魔物及其^006400等级^000000。这些信息以红色显示，很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you want to stop looking at the map, there are 2 ways to do this.
You can press the shortcut keys which are ^006400CTRL + %^000000 or ^006400ESC^000000
Or at the top right of the map, there is a ^006400X^000000 button. Click that and you will return to your normal game screen.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
如果你想关闭地图，有两种方法。
你可以按下快捷键^006400CTRL + %^000000或^006400ESC^000000。
或者在地图的右上角，有一个^006400X^000000按钮。点击它即可返回正常游戏画面。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Currently, we cannot see places that are beyond Midgard but it has been said that there are a lot of unknown worlds that exist in the beyond.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
目前，我们还无法看到米德加尔特之外的地方，但据说在远方存在着许多未知的世界。
